description: Awesome Industrial Datasets is a structured directory of resources for industrial data analysis and monitoring. The current README enumerates 190 entries and links to individual Markdown descriptions. Its table records domain, asset or process, modality, intended task, annotation type, source type, access route, size, year and licence where known. Named resources cover industrial processes, components, buildings, electricity and water systems, with both measured and simulated data. Coverage is international and spans independently dated releases, not one observation period or spatial resolution. The directory is freely accessible through GitHub under CC BY-NC 4.0; this licence does not replace the licences of linked datasets. A limitation is substantial missing metadata, overlapping benchmark variants and access labels that require checking at each provider. Enumeration of all 190 metadata entries is underway in this review, but their underlying resources are not all verified. Simulation uses include finding calibration or fault-monitoring inputs and comparing available benchmark structures. It complements data-nasa-prognostics-data-repository and data-tennessee-eastman-process-anomaly-detection, both named resource families within this broader discovery context. The earlier rejection solely as a link list conflicts with the reuse rule for useful information sources.
